issues.failure_explanation: The map q_delta has rank d-1: u^e composed with q_delta is the constant-normal extension of the trace of u^e on partial Omega_delta. An H^s bulk function generally has only an H^{s-1/2} trace, so its constant-normal lifting is not bounded in H^s by the bulk H^s norm. Consequently the H^{p+1} bound used to obtain the h^p interpolation estimates for I_1, I_{2,2}, and I_{2,3} is false even if the projection geometry is uniformly smooth.
